_case: Password grant turned on. This is realm finding R4 landing on a client: the realm advertises the password grant, and the mitigation is per-client. It reintroduces the in-app credential-entry surface federation exists to remove.

client.name: Dotmac Field (native, pre-rollout)
client.description: Public native OIDC client for the field_mobile artifact. DISABLED until a verified App Link and Universal Link exist (ADR-0069 §7 / R1) and the dotmac_sub ID-token exchange endpoint exists (ADR-0069 §3). The client id matches the Android application id and the iOS bundle id, because ADR-0069 §2 makes a client per ARTIFACT identity.
